must_include: All counterfactual quantities are labeled model-implied and conditional on the estimated structure.
Approval, entry, borrower-surplus, lender-profit, and total-surplus changes are reported as distinct margins.
The total-surplus estimate of +0.6% is paired with its −0.2% to +1.4% bootstrap interval.
The seven-of-eight targeted fit and 18% untargeted duration miss are both disclosed.
Equal welfare weights, omitted default externalities, and omitted funding-cost equilibrium responses bound the welfare interpretation.
must_avoid: Saying the data prove the counterfactual or welfare result.
Calling the total-surplus gain statistically or economically certain.
Hiding lender-entry and lender-profit losses behind borrower gains.
Inventing a new fit test, policy response, externality, or citation.
human_review: Fit, identification, counterfactual mechanics, incidence, and welfare are not rhetorically conflated.
Uncertainty and model misspecification remain visible near the headline result.
The section explains which omitted margins could change the welfare ranking.
